mapper.select: SELECT sku_id, sku_name FROM sku WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT sales_point_id FROM sales_point WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 AND sales_point_id IN
#{salesPointId}

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(balance.stock_sales_point_id, balance.allocated_sales_point_id) AS sales_point_id FROM inventory_balance balance INNER JOIN sales_point point ON point.sales_point_id = COALESCE( balance.stock_sales_point_id, balance.allocated_sales_point_id ) AND point.active_yn = 'Y' AND point.is_deleted = 0 WHERE balance.sku_id = #{skuId} AND balance.on_hand_qty > 0 AND balance.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE( balance.stock_sales_point_id, balance.allocated_sales_point_id ) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sales_point_id

SELECT lot.lot_id, lot.sku_id, lot.lot_status, lot.expiry_date, lot.sale_stop_date, ( SELECT MIN(balance.warehouse_id) FROM inventory_balance balance WHERE balance.lot_id = lot.lot_id AND balance.is_deleted = 0 ) AS warehouse_id FROM lot WHERE lot.is_deleted = 0 AND lot.lot_id IN
#{lotId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_case ( sku_id, created_by, updated_by, retry_parent_case_id, requested_sales_point_id, case_code, case_name, case_status, request_payload_json, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{skuId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{retryParentCaseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{requestedSalesPointId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{caseCode}, #{caseName}, #{caseStatus}, #{requestPayloadJson}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT strategy_case_id, retry_parent_case_id, sku_id, requested_sales_point_id, case_code, case_name, case_status, generation_stage, recommendation_outcome, request_payload_json, result_cache_key, result_expires_at, failure_code, failure_message, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted FROM strategy_case WHERE strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT strategy_case_id, retry_parent_case_id, sku_id, requested_sales_point_id, case_code, case_name, case_status, generation_stage, recommendation_outcome, request_payload_json, result_cache_key, result_expires_at, failure_code, failure_message, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted FROM strategy_case WHERE strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT strategy_case_id, retry_parent_case_id, sku_id, requested_sales_point_id, case_code, case_name, case_status, generation_stage, recommendation_outcome, request_payload_json, result_cache_key, result_expires_at, failure_code, failure_message, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted FROM strategy_case WHERE retry_parent_case_id = #{retryParentCaseId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy_case SET generation_stage = 'FORECASTING', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = created_by WHERE strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND case_status = 'GENERATING' AND generation_stage IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE strategy_case SET generation_stage = 'STRATEGY_GENERATING', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = created_by WHERE strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND case_status = 'GENERATING' AND generation_stage = 'FORECASTING' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE strategy_case SET case_status = 'GENERATED', generation_stage = 'COMPARISON_READY', recommendation_outcome = #{recommendationOutcome}, result_cache_key = #{resultCacheKey}, result_expires_at = #{resultExpiresAt}, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = created_by WHERE strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND case_status = 'GENERATING' AND generation_stage = 'STRATEGY_GENERATING' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE strategy_case SET case_status = 'GENERATION_FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = created_by WHERE strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND case_status = 'GENERATING' AND generation_stage IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE strategy_case SET case_status = 'GENERATION_FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = created_by WHERE strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND case_status = 'GENERATING' AND generation_stage = #{expectedStage} AND is_deleted = 0
